messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — we're planning to start emitting the new `x-rw-client-version` handshake header in v3 next month. Need a quick sync on whether we offer an opt-in runtime shim for older SDKs or force clients to upgrade.
kevin.c: can we do a shim behind a feature-flag? default off for hosted, on for Dedicated as a migration assist? :thinking_face:
jonah: +1 for feature-flagged shim. worried about long tail and people relying on old header semantics. we should track usage if we enable it.
maria.g: Agreed. Proposal: ship a lightweight HTTP shim that maps `x-rw-client` -> `x-rw-client-version` and normalizes versions. Only enable per-tenant via `compat:legacy-header` flag. Telemetry event `compat.shim_used` emitted on first hit per tenant.
lucy.sre: need perf numbers. if shim is per-request parsing we could add latency. how cheap is this mapping in the runtime?
kevin.c: it's just a header transform; negligible CPU but adds branching in the fast-path. we can gate it at edge-proxy level (envoy filter) to avoid touching kernel hot path.
jonah: env filter sounds safe. also: what about streaming connections (websockets)? header only on initial upgrade, but some SDKs set header per-req. need uniform behavior.
maria.g: for WS we'll do the same transform on upgrade request. for multipart/stream we should not mutate mid-stream. document that shim only affects handshake.
kevin.c: rollout plan suggestion: 1) internal canary tenants (5%) w/ flag on, 2) expand to 20% next week if no regressions, 3) offer tenant opt-in via console toggle for enterprise, 4) leave flag available for 90 days then remove by default.
jonah: add alerting: rate of `compat.shim_used` spikes, error ratio > 0.5%, p99 latency +20ms — trigger pager.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline job queued: "canary-compat-shim-v1" — started. (job id: dp-6791)
lucy.sre: Can we attach a short-lived debug header when shim is active so apps can see translation? e.g. `x-rw-compat: shim-v1` so we can correlate traces.
maria.g: yes, add `x-rw-compat: shim-v1` on responses when shim applied. we'll add a note in docs.
kevin.c: SDK owners: please push patch that emits telemetry when they see `x-rw-compat` so we can count adoption on client side too.
jonah: open questions: TTL for flag (90 days ok?), migration assist for Dedicated (maybe 180 days?), and legal/enterprise notice requirements.
maria.g: draft action items: - kevin -> implement envoy filter + response header (ETA 3d) - jonah -> alert + dashboard + pager rules (ETA 2d) - lucy -> performance smoke test (ETA 2d) - maria -> doc + console toggle + enterprise comms (ETA 4d).
kevin.c: ack. will post PR link when ready.
jonah: I'll add a small eval that simulates 10k rps with shim on/off to validate p99 impact.
maria.g: thanks all. we'll reconvene after canary, tag this thread with postmortem if anything pops. :thumbsup:
